requirements.title: Investigation Script System
requirements.description: The system shall expose and execute the predefined investigation catalog through API endpoints, selecting native execution or an explicitly declared shell-gated path with honest unsupported results.

validation.notes: Test catalog loading, native execution, shell JSON validation, and durable run persistence
Verify six catalog entries, two shell escape hatches, four native entries, and platform/tool metadata
Runtime matrix records every catalog entry below the 60-second execution guard and below the 30-second observed target
Operator panel renders catalog metadata and executes entries through the API
